verdict.rationale: PagerDuty ships a dedicated Status Pages product that is explicitly driven from incident state and lets teams communicate real-time operational updates without leaving PagerDuty (pagerduty-docs-10, pagerduty-docs-17, pagerduty-docs-24). However, the evidence never confirms custom-domain hosting or subscriber notification/opt-in mechanics for the status page. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of custom domain support, subscriber sign-up/notification delivery, and any independent/hands-on confirmation of these specific features.
